$meta.name: Travel app design tokens - sprint 8 additions
$meta.status: Draft for Raz. DELTA ONLY on top of 0.8.0: every key below is new; no existing value changes; no new colours. Merge into docs/design/tokens.json and apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts in the same PR that first uses them (docs/design/sprint-08/README.md section 23). Keys starting with '$check.' are contrast documentation only and are not merged into tokens.ts.
layout.sosButton.note: Offset above insets.bottom = layout.tripsButton.bottom (16) + TripsButton height (48) + 12 gap: one row above 'My trips', on the end side (left in RTL). Same visibility as TripsButton plus 'an active trip exists'; hidden while the country card, search, a sheet, My trips or a form is open (README 14).
color.sos.map: No new colours. Background color.dark.status.alert.bg (#FF5D52) and label color.dark.status.alert.fg (#060B18) in BOTH themes, because the globe is always dark (globe.status). Outline: globe.final.selectionRing.underlayColor (#03060F) at globe.final.selectionRing.underlayOpacity (0.6), width size.sosButton.underlayWidth (README 14.1).
color.driverCard.map: No new colours. The driver card always uses color.light.bg.surface and color.light.text.* (primary, secondary), also in dark mode; status bar style 'dark' (README 6.1).
color.dial.map: No new colours. Local emergency numbers (police, ambulance, fire, general, tourist police): status.alert.bg/fg circle. Everything else (mission, insurance, Foreign Ministry, hotel): action.secondary.bg/fg circle (README 12.3).
type.dial.note: Numbers with up to shortMaxDigits digits (191, 1669) use type.numeric.lg in the full SOS row; international E.164 numbers use type.numeric.md. Always LTR isolate, tabular figures, never truncated.
type.driver.local.note: adjustsFontSizeToFit with minimumFontScale = min/max (0.545); allowFontScaling false on this block only; scrolls if it still does not fit at the minimum. Direction and alignment from the content (textDirection), not from the UI language (README 6.2, 19.2).
limits.sprint8.note: bookingRefMax and policyMax (40) are a proposal: the sprint scope does not fix them (README question 5). Counted in Unicode code points after trim, as limits.note.
motion.fullScreen.note: DriverCard and SosScreen: content on the first frame (spec 12.3, critical information is never delayed). Close is a 150 fade (= motion.duration.reduceFadeOut).
$check.contrast.method: WCAG 2.x relative luminance, (L1+0.05)/(L2+0.05), on the hex values in tokens.ts. Text 4.5:1, graphics 3:1 (1.4.11).
